title: Crane games
content: I have had these dreams sporadically throughout life ..but going to an arcade usually in some big cool mall and winning just ass tons of stuffed animals from various crane games. And it is like a huge winners high and it's so exciting...like being a kid and winning one....and then there's almost always some insanely decedent food court or buffet involved as well that has so much amazing food. ....these are my favorite dreams ever. I've had at least 1 of them a year.
